description: Holds US Dollar Index futures while the 50-day average is above the 200-day average, cash otherwise. The dollar trends with the Federal Reserve cycle. Falsified if dollar trends are too short for a 50/200 filter. Backtested on FinzData currency futures: front-month contract rolled on the FinzData roll calendar as an excess-return index, so the interest-rate differential (carry) is in the return; costs as stated, re-run free on full history.
title: US Dollar Index trend · /DX 50/200 moving average
